exhibits.title: Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• The Body: Lord Arthur Vance found slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Jasper Moore at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Jasper Moore loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • Desk & Floor Notes: Unsigned New Will; untouched crystal wine glass; single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); broken pocket watch; shattered glass beside a 5-lb brass counterweight in spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Jasper Moore snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-4632)

The Killer: Jasper Moore (#6)
The Accomplice (Shadow Team): Sebastian Cole (#11)
The Inspector: Clara Sterling (#2)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the brass-capped flask of black workshop coffee handed to him by Jasper Moore (#6) at 8:42 PM. At 9:01 PM, Jasper Moore rushed to the desk first, pocketing the brass-capped flask of black workshop coffee and later ditching a botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute.

Victor Vance (#5) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Sebastian Cole (#11) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the brass-capped flask of black workshop coffee; (3) Jasper Moore slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C flagged both "J.M." and "S.C.", but Exhibit E clears Sebastian Cole (no 2008 access) and ties Jasper Moore directly to 2008 Lab Safety — Sabotaged Prototype Test — Vance Precision Intern & Lab Assistant (Summer 2008); hired full-time 2012!
